Millennials built coping mechanisms.
And somehow… it’s the coffee’s fault.

Video

When people are hurting, they look for answers.

The problem is…
some answers are easier than the truth.

Video

We celebrate who gets a seat at the table…
but not enough people can afford the meal.

Equality isn’t just about who gets in.
It’s about who can actually afford to stay.

Video

So apparently…

you don’t see the world with your eyes.
Your brain just… vibes with the data.

Now “waking up on the wrong side of the bed” makes sense. 😅

Video

Your dog looks at you and feels love.

Your cat looks at you and thinks…
“you live here too?”

We need to stop calling it “your cat".

Are you team dog or team cat?

Video

Success isn’t always strategy.

Sometimes it’s just showing up,
staying humble,
and treating people like… people.

Video

“We the people” is beautiful.

The only problem is…
Everyone has a different idea of who “the people” are.

Video

Looking back, I realize we didn’t just survive that day—we carried it with us.

My biggest regret isn't what happened; it’s that we didn't talk to anyone about it afterwards.

Trauma doesn't care how old you are. It stays in the shadows until you bring it into the light. Therapy isn't just for 'problems'; it’s for healing the things you didn't even know were broken.

#MentalHealth #Healing #whatnowpodcast
